notes.title: Early Access Update 3
notes.notes:
Hello Agents, the third update for LIZ: Before the Plague is finally here!

This update should have been ready at least two weeks ago, but you all know about the COVID19 alert and all the related consequences. We've been among the first studios to enable smart working (we're home since the first days of March). Smart working is not new to us, we normally allow our team to work remotely on some occasions so technically we were prepared, but not being in contact slowed down the work.

[previewyoutube=m9IF_UUZHfE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]What's new?[/h2]
We added another playable room and thanks to your suggestions we fixed some bugs and improved the game experience.

CHANGELOG (Revision v0.4)
[list]
[*] Added a new playable room
[*] New character met
[*] Improved loading after a new game and overall loading times
[*] Improved some broken animations
[*] Fixed temporary malfuncitoning of the scanner app, reported by few players
[/list]

[h2]Know Issues[/h2]
There are still few known issues we are still working on:
[list]
[*] Dark colors banding on some graphics cards, especially using Oculus Rift
[*] The response of the Windows Mixed Reality analog stick is not what is expected, some fixes are still needed
[*] Rare framerate  drops during certain phases of the game on some hardware
[*] Some players reported few-seconds random freezes, we're still investigating since we couldn't reproduce them yet
[/list]

[h2]Support & Feedbacks[/h2]
Thank you for all the support and feedback during the days after release, you can expect more to come, as well as some new content that we are working on.
Continue to stay tuned for other updates, we also would like to have you on our discord channel, here you can talk with devs, send your feedback, receive assistance and help us to improve our product!
Join us on https://discordapp.com/invite/wGWxXcR

notes.title: Early Access Update 2 - Patch 1.2
notes.notes:
Hello Agents!

We hed a few feedbacks from players about some issues that could come up occasionally, so we decided to release a quick patch containing almost all what could be done without affecting the development of the next releases.

[previewyoutube=m9IF_UUZHfE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Windows Mixed Reality[/b] Holographic Controller Binding updated to enhance usability (3D model rotation is still sticky on some devices, we'll redesign the input mapping specifically for WMR in a major update)
[*] [b]Fixed a few bugs[/b] which came up rarely during certain playthroughs (we tested everything a lot on pretty much any kind of hardware and we didn't encounter any blocking bug, let us know if you find any)
[*] Updated some [b]graphical assets[/b]
[/list]

[h2]Bug Reports[/h2]
We have a dedicated discord channel for [b]support and bug tracking[/b]. Please join us on discord and let us know if something goes wrong while you play. The more info you can give us about [b]how[/b] problems come up, the easier for us to fix them!
Join u son Discord! https://discordapp.com/invite/wGWxXcR

[h2]Support & Feedbacks[/h2]
Thank you for all the support and feedback during the days after release, you can expect more to come, as well as some new content that we are working on.

notes.title: Early Access Update 2
notes.notes:
Hello Agents, the second update for LIZ: Before the Plague is finally here!
It took a little time because we were slowed down by the Christmas holidays and after that we had to reorganize the team to meet some feedback that we received from our players, but finally we can release the update!

[previewyoutube=m9IF_UUZHfE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]What's new?[/h2]
We added another playable room and thanks to your suggestions we fixed some bugs and improved the game experience.

CHANGELOG (Revision v0.3)
[list]
[*] Added a new playable room
[*] Added Windows Mixed Reality support

[*] Improved loading after a new game
